snippet.title: Puzzle Simulator: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

Wishlist now on Steam, link in profile.
